observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor running track at night, public space
observation.dancers: two men, solo dancing in turns
observation.formation_and_space: the dancers occupy the space in front of the camera, moving laterally and forward
observation.posture: torso is slightly bent forward, knees are bent and springy
observation.footwork: the core movement is a rhythmic, rapid lifting of one knee while the other foot hops on the beat, often alternating legs; the feet are lifted high and the movement is energetic
observation.arms_and_hands: arms are held out to the sides or bent at the elbows, moving in sync with the leg lifts; sometimes hands are used to hold or adjust clothing
observation.hips_and_torso: the torso remains relatively upright but follows the rhythmic bounce of the legs
observation.partnering: none, the dancers perform solo in turns
observation.levels_jumps_turns: the dance is performed at a standing level with constant hopping; no floor work or complex turns are observed
observation.costume_and_props: casual street clothes: jackets, jeans, sneakers, and beanies
observation.cannot_infer: the low-resolution and fast-paced movement make it difficult to determine the exact weight transfer or the precision of the footwork on every beat

signature_moments.what: a dancer performs a rapid, high-knee hop, alternating legs while keeping a steady, energetic rhythm
a dancer executes a series of quick, high-knee lifts, emphasizing the upbeat of the music
